macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin falls 7.76% and drops to 17th among global assets
items.summary: Bitcoin’s market capitalization fell to approximately $1.26 trillion after a 7.76% 24-hour decline, moving it out of the top 15 global assets by market value.

items.title: SEC declines enforcement recommendation over Canton Coin
items.summary: The SEC’s Division of Corporation Finance reportedly said it would not recommend enforcement over Canton Coin’s programmatic minting, characterizing it as a digital commodity rather than a security.

items.title: France advances disclosure requirement for high-value self-hosted wallets
items.summary: France’s National Assembly adopted an amendment requiring declarations for self-hosted crypto wallets worth at least €100,000, with potential fines of up to €10,000 for noncompliance.

items.title: Centrifuge launches tokenized Schroders debt fund on Solana
items.summary: Centrifuge launched a tokenized emerging-markets debt fund from Schroders on Solana, representing the asset manager’s first deployment on the network.

items.title: USDC Treasury mints $250 million on Solana
items.summary: USDC Treasury reportedly minted 250 million USDC on Solana, worth approximately $250 million, adding significant new stablecoin supply to the network.

items.title: Telegram reports more than 1 million self-custodial wallets activated
items.summary: Telegram founder Pavel Durov said more than 1 million self-custodial wallets were activated on the platform within 48 hours, highlighting rapid wallet distribution through messaging infrastructure.

items.title: Hyperliquid repurchases and burns 47,700 HYPE tokens
items.summary: Hyperliquid reportedly repurchased and destroyed 47,700 HYPE tokens worth approximately $3.17 million, bringing cumulative token destruction to about 50.59 million HYPE.

items.title: Central banks test blockchain-based foreign-exchange settlement
items.summary: The Bank of England, Monetary Authority of Singapore, and Bank of Thailand reportedly tested Project Meridian FX APAC for cross-border foreign-exchange settlement across blockchain and conventional systems.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Google announces Gemini 4 models and new AI infrastructure
items.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon for complex coding and cyber-defense tasks and Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, lower-cost model. The company also announced new TPU systems, updates to Gemini Robotics, AlphaGenome 2, and Android XR audio glasses.[1]

items.title: Runway releases open-weight Praxis-1 robot-control model
items.summary: Runway released the weights and inference and training code for Praxis-1, a roughly 27-billion-parameter robot-control model available commercially under the Apache 2.0 license.[2]

items.title: OpenAI reports mathematical and theoretical computer-science results from Astra
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly published ten new results produced by an internal version of Astra, its next major model family, including solutions involving open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science.[4]

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude into meetings and manufacturing
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings in beta for Team and Enterprise customers, allowing Claude to participate in Google Meet calls and generate notes and action items. It also introduced Claude for Manufacturing, a specialized enterprise plugin.[5]

items.title: Perplexity releases open decision models
items.summary: Perplexity reportedly released Decider v1.3 and Decider Flash v1.3, adding verbatim text-span extraction; the models’ weights are available under Apache 2.0.[5]

items.title: AI agents audit scientific reference works
items.summary: Researchers are using AI agents to review scientific literature and identify errors that have persisted in reference works for decades, highlighting a growing use of agentic systems in research quality control.[4]

items.title: Meta opens AI phone-calling feature to premium subscribers
items.summary: Meta reportedly expanded Muse’s phone-calling capability to subscribers on its highest-tier Meta AI plan, priced from $19.99 per month.[6]

items.title: Anthropic introduces FlashProve for model-output verification
items.summary: Anthropic introduced FlashProve, a prototype designed to prove that an output came from a committed model without revealing its weights, pointing toward new cryptographic approaches to AI-model provenance.[9]

items.title: AI agents deployed for real-time radio astronomy operations
items.summary: The Allen Telescope Array is reportedly using agentic AI to steer antennas, process incoming data, and apply analysis models through natural-language requests, with NVIDIA hardware supporting high-throughput sensor processing.[9]

items.title: Industry focus shifts toward physical AI and robotics
items.summary: Recent developments from Google DeepMind and NVIDIA underscore continued investment in vision-language-action models, robot foundation models, reinforcement learning, and large-scale simulation for embodied AI.[3]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launch nears with 24-hour livestream
items.summary: Rockstar Games and YouTube are reportedly planning a 24-hour livestream beginning at midnight ET on November 19, coinciding with Grand Theft Auto VI’s launch. A roughly 1 GB mandatory update has also appeared for preloaded copies, though its contents have not been disclosed.

items.title: GTA VI expected to drive a broad gaming-economy surge
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is projected to generate significant demand for consoles, accessories, digital platforms and streaming services when it launches on November 19. The game is slated for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with PC and Nintendo Switch 2 versions not yet available at launch.

items.title: GTA VI multiplayer reportedly targeted for late 2027
items.summary: Media reports citing industry insiders suggest GTA VI’s online multiplayer could arrive in late 2027, potentially about a year after the single-player release. Rockstar has not officially confirmed a multiplayer launch window.

items.title: Logitech offers employees annual gaming day
items.summary: Logitech announced that more than 7,000 employees will receive a flexible paid day off each year to play any video game, an initiative attracting attention ahead of GTA VI’s release.

items.title: League of Legends: New Dawn teased for 2027
items.summary: A new League of Legends project titled New Dawn received an official teaser, with a full reveal scheduled for January and release planned for later in 2027.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after global outage
items.summary: Microsoft reported that its services had been fully restored after an hourslong global outage. The incident was among the leading technology developments reported over the past 24 hours.[1]

items.title: Meta fined $887 million in Italy over Facebook media handling
items.summary: Italian authorities fined Meta $887 million over the handling of Android gallery photos and videos on Facebook, adding to regulatory pressure on the company.[1]

items.title: Amazon launches premium Kindle Colorsoft e-reader
items.summary: Amazon introduced a new Kindle Colorsoft, positioning the color e-reader as a premium device with a correspondingly high price.[2]
